questions.prompt: What experience, hierarchy, tone, and explicit negative constraints should guide the design?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD outcomes and scope, product patterns, and approved references
questions.purpose: Translate Product outcomes into an experience direction with explicit anti-patterns.
questions.completion_evidence: States experience direction, hierarchy or tone, and at least one negative constraint linked to Product outcomes.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the intended experience direction and explicit design constraints or anti-patterns.

questions.prompt: Where does each journey begin and end, and which routes, surfaces, and navigation transitions cover every PRD flow?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD flows and stories, existing routes, and the navigation model
questions.purpose: Map every visual Product journey to resolvable routes and transitions.
questions.completion_evidence: Names journey entry and end points plus routes, surfaces, and transitions or a justified non-visual decision.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the journey entry and end points and the routes, surfaces, or non-visual decision that covers them.

questions.prompt: What layout regions, containment, information priority, scrolling, and responsive structure are required?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD journeys and users, existing shells, grids, breakpoints, and platform conventions
questions.purpose: Define structural hierarchy and responsive containment without implementation guesswork.
questions.completion_evidence: Names layout regions, containment and priority, scrolling behavior, and relevant responsive changes.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the layout regions, information priority, scrolling behavior, and responsive structure.

questions.prompt: Which components are reused, modified, or new, and what inputs, states, and ownership does each require?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD stories and dependencies, component library, current implementation, and design system
questions.purpose: Produce a resolvable component and data-binding contract.
questions.completion_evidence: Distinguishes reused, modified, and new components and identifies inputs, states, and ownership.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please distinguish reused, modified, and new components and add their inputs, states, or owners.

questions.prompt: What happens in default, loading, empty, partial, error, permission, disabled, success, offline, and overflow states?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD happy, boundary, failure, and recovery flows plus existing patterns and defects
questions.purpose: Prevent happy-path-only design by making boundary and recovery behavior explicit.
questions.completion_evidence: Covers applicable happy, loading, empty, partial, error, permission, disabled, success, offline, and overflow states.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the missing boundary, failure, permission, offline, overflow, or recovery states that materially apply.

questions.prompt: How do actions, validation feedback, recovery, focus, keyboard behavior, motion, and user-facing copy work?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD interaction and control obligations, content standards, accessibility rules, and interaction patterns
questions.purpose: Make interaction, recovery, accessibility, motion, and content behavior observable.
questions.completion_evidence: Defines actions, validation and recovery, focus or keyboard behavior, motion, and user-facing content constraints.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the missing validation, recovery, focus, keyboard, motion, or user-facing copy behavior.

questions.prompt: Which existing spacing, typography, color, depth, icon, and imagery tokens apply, and which primitives are genuinely new?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD scope and dependencies, closed token set, and design-system documentation
questions.purpose: Keep visual decisions inside the resolved design system and label genuine additions.
questions.completion_evidence: References applicable existing token families and explicitly labels any unresolved or new primitive.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please identify the existing token families to reuse and any primitive that must be introduced or resolved.

questions.prompt: How does the experience adapt across viewport, platform, localization, reduced motion, assistive technology, and accessibility targets?
questions.evidence: Linked PRD users, success and control obligations, breakpoints, supported platforms, localization rules, and WCAG target
questions.purpose: Make adaptation and accessibility requirements testable across supported contexts.
questions.completion_evidence: Defines viewport or platform adaptation, localization, reduced motion, assistive technology behavior, accessibility target, and verification evidence.

quality.follow_up_prompt: Please add the missing viewport, platform, localization, reduced-motion, assistive-technology, accessibility-target, or verification behavior.
